title: KB5L: tau >= 1 box floor PROVEN at v = 5 - shareable class narrowed - no kappa
body:
# KB5L: the tau >= 1 box floor at v = 5 is PROVEN - shareable class narrowed (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5L** (authorized explicit open request from the [handoff thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166); scope changed from the drawn `complex-new-helper-inventory` card, recorded in `TASK.json`): the **first open case of the tau >= 1 box floor (v = 5)** and the **shareable-class remainder** - the recorded remainders of [PR 3012](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3012) (agent-79).

**Answer (a): PROVEN.** Every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_{j<=3} p_j q_j^T` on `v = 5` lines with `M_tt != 0` and `tau(t) >= 1` on every line has `box(M) >= 3 = floor(2v/3)`. The tau >= 1 box floor is now PROVEN for `v <= 5`; the first open case moves to `v = 6`. The mechanism is a **rank obstruction**, not a keepable count and not matched pivots: combinatorially the only way to keep `box` at 2 is a complete zero-arc digraph inside a 2-bit label-cap family, and a complete zero-arc digraph makes `M` diagonal, which has rank 5 - impossible for a 3-total decoder.

**Answer (b): narrowed.** PR 2978's `3 realized / 3 unrealizable-column / 21 not-found-in-cap` split is replayed exactly (same seed and stages); a strictly larger bounded push (exact kernel q-solver at 10,000 P-restarts per pattern plus the big alphabet at 2,000) realizes none of the 21; and **1 of the 21 is PROVEN unrealizable** (the pattern `(a0, b0) = (3^3, 3^3)` with complete `Z`: the anchor screen gives `p_2 == 0`, so `rank(M) <= 2`, but complete `Z` forces diagonal rank 3). The other 20 stay CHECKED not-found-in-cap. This also corrects PR 3012's framing: only 20 of the 21 lie in the shareable class (`r_box = 3`); the settled one forces `r_box = 2`.

F-star (`cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)`) is **not** proved and **not** refuted. Claims are labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / DEMOTED.

## CORE: the v = 5 tau >= 1 verdict

| stage | object | result | label |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 5-line type multisets, tau >= 1 | 749,398 enumerated; envelope `box = 2` on exactly 33 | PROVEN (exhaustive) |
| 2 | the 33 families under the anchor screen | 15 unrealizable; 6 shapes survive | PROVEN (written) |
| 3 | blocking zero-arc sets per shape | only the complete digraph blocks every triple | PROVEN (exact) |
| 4 | complete digraph at rank <= 3 | diagonal `M` has rank 5 > 3 | PROVEN (written) |
| 5 | realizable replay | 120 tau-forced decoders, exact box >= 5, witnesses replayed | CHECKED |
| 6 | bounded falsifier hunt | 35 instances, 0 hits | CHECKED (bounded) |

**The reduction (written; engine-anchored definitions).** `box(M)` is the largest kept set over in-box labels `a(t) <= a0(t)`, `b(t) <= b0(t)` with `K_tt = 1` on kept lines and `K_ts = 0` at every zero arc `(t, s)` with `t` before `s` in the kept order. (R1) `box` depends only on `(a0, b0, Z)` (Lemma SB; labels of non-kept lines never enter a constraint). (R2) `box` is non-increasing in `Z`, so `box(Z) >= box(Z_even)` with `Z_even` the set of all pairs of even `|a0(t) intersect b0(s)|`. (R3) Lemma SG ([PR 2869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2869), PROVEN; machine-asserted on every realizable instance here) forces every realizable zero arc into `Z_even`; the engine's scope identity is the exact iff: `dot1(a0[t], b0[s]) = 1` if and only if `M_ts != 0` and `v2(M_ts) = gamma`. So a realizable `box = 2` decoder must sit inside a `box = 2` combinatorial envelope `(a0, b0, Z_even)`, and its actual `Z` must block every triple in every order.

**Stage 1 (PROVEN, exhaustive).** All `C(41,5) = 749,398` multisets of 5 raw line types (`(a0, b0)` mask pairs with `tau = |a0 intersect b0| >= 1`; raw masks preserve the joint bit structure that per-line canonicalization loses) are enumerated with `Z = Z_even`: memoized singleton witnesses first, the exact kept-set ladder (pinned to an independent definition-level brute enumeration on 400 random configs) as fallback. Result: `PASS_KL_V5 configs=749398 cheap=749347 exact=18 envelope-box2-families=33`. All 33 families share one shape: every pair-intersection even (`Z_even` complete) and one label side confined to 2 bits (a rank-2 cap on in-box `K = A B^T`) - exactly the Lemma RT + shareable-totals route [PR 3012](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3012) recorded as the only possible falsifier shape.

**Stage 2 (PROVEN, written).** From the engine's `anchor_data`: `a0_j(t) = [v2(p_j(t)) = m_j]` with `m_j` a minimum over nonzero column entries; `b0_j(t) = [v2(q_j(t)) = gamma - m_j]`. Hence (A1) bit `j` in no `a0(t)` implies `p_j == 0` identically (minima are attained), so `rank(M) <= 2`; (A2) bit `j` in some `b0(t)` requires `m_j` finite and `c_j = gamma`, so a family with bit `j` in some `b0` but in no `a0` is unrealizable. The screen rejects 15 of the 33 and leaves 6 shapes up to total relabeling (5 unshareable-total rank-3 shapes, 1 zero-p-column rank-2 shape): `PASS_KL_SHAPES shapes=6 screen-rejected=15`.

**Stage 3 (PROVEN, exact).** Per surviving shape, exact per-triple blocking tables (kept-3 infeasibility of the 3-line ladder over all 2^6 arc patterns) are combined with a full 2^20 arc-subset enumeration. In every shape the only subset blocking all ten triples is the **complete digraph** (`blocking=1 minimal=1` each): with one non-arc `(x, y)`, the order `(x, y, z)` leaves `K_xy` free and the 2-bit cap can always be met with `det(K[S,S]) = 0`.

**Stage 4 (PROVEN, written).** Complete `Z` makes `M` diagonal with nonzero diagonal, so `rank(M) = 5 > 3`; no exact 3-total decoder exists with `v = 5`, `tau >= 1` everywhere and `box < 3`. The rank-2 shapes fail a fortiori. This is the same obstruction PR 2978's realized `v = 3` counterexample family sidesteps only because a 3x3 diagonal has rank 3.

**Corroboration (CHECKED).** `PASS_KL_REALIZABLE_V5 instances=120 violations=0 min-box=5` (tau-forced generator; identities asserted; exact box by the vendored engine; in-box witnesses replayed). `PASS_KL_HUNT tested=35 hits=0` (tau-targeted, PR 2978-core extensions, nullspace-dense; ladder-exact criterion; bounded, not a non-existence result). `PASS_KL_PROBE model-ok=142 tau>=1-all=0`: untargeted random entries make all-5-lines `tau >= 1` rare, which is why the combinatorial envelope route is the decisive one.

## Shareable class: the 21-pattern remainder

`shareable_v3.py` recomputes PR 2978 job B from scratch (the vendored receipt ships empty): `PASS_KJ_V3 configs=3023 box-equals-cert=2996 candidates=27`. Pass 1 replays PR 2978's `realize_kj.py` pipeline exactly (seed 20261017, same stages and caps) and reproduces its recorded split, `PASS_KL_SHAREABLE candidates=27 replay={"not-found-in-cap": 21, "realized": 3, "unrealizable-column": 3}`. Pass 2 pushes the cap with an exact kernel q-solver: for fixed `P` (anchor recipe), `q(s)` lies in the integer kernel of its zero-arc predecessor rows, avoids the off-arc hyperplanes, and matches the parity box; a solution exists iff `p(t)` is outside `span{p(u) : (u, s) in Z}` for every non-arc `t`. 10,000 deterministic P-restarts per pattern plus the vendored big alphabet at 2,000: **no new realization** (`push-final` equals `replay`). One pattern is PROVEN unrealizable (candidate 7; A1 + diagonal rank). The remaining 20 are shareable-class (`r_box = 3`) and stay CHECKED not-found-in-cap.

**Methodological caveat (CHECKED observation, not a proof).** PR 2978 job B's canonicalization applies total relabeling per line (`canon_total` on each line's `(a0, b0)` separately) and computes pair parities from the chosen representatives. Total relabeling is a global operation on the shared bit indices, so two joint structures with the same multiset of per-line canonical types can have different cross-line parities and therefore different `Z` spaces. The recorded 3023-pattern census may under-count the joint `(a0, b0, Z)` space, so "the 21" (or 20) may not be the complete gap-candidate set at `v = 3`. The v = 5 enumeration in this package is unaffected (raw joint type multisets preserve cross-line structure). A joint-sound v = 3 census is the natural follow-up check.

## What this does and does not say about F-star

Nothing here lowers `cert` on any instance. The box rung of `cert >= max(named, box)` now carries the threshold on the entire tau >= 1 domain for `v <= 5`, and the named/matched-pivot rung carries the `tau = 0` region (PR 3012's falsifiers all have `cert = v`). The shareable-class question is about `box = cert` completeness, not about the threshold: even a realized gap pattern would not falsify F-star, since its `cert` would still have to drop below `floor(2v/3)` - which no falsifier test in the lineage has produced.

## What is proved, checked, demoted

- **PROVEN:** the tau >= 1 box floor at `v = 5` (four-stage chain above); the envelope classification (33 families); the anchor-attainment screen (15 rejected); the blocking-Z result (complete digraph only); unrealizability of one v = 3 shareable pattern.
- **CHECKED (machine, deterministic):** ladder pinned to definition-level brute on 400 configs; 120 realizable tau-forced decoders with replayed witnesses; the 35-instance bounded hunt; the exact PR 2978 classification replay and the cap push.
- **DEMOTED / OPEN:** `v = 6` (threshold 4) is the new first open case of the tau >= 1 floor; the 20 remaining shareable-class patterns are not-found-in-cap, not proven unrealizable; the matched-pivot floor stays demoted.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, Python 3.10+ (registered replay: 3.12):

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-boxfloor-v5-seedab80f07c/verify.py
python3 -B research/fstar-boxfloor-v5-seedab80f07c/predecessor/pr3012/anchor_replay.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-boxfloor-v5-seedab80f07c --check-only
```

Observed: `PASS_KL_PINS vendored-pr3012=57`; `PASS_KL_PIN configs=400 brute-equals-ladder=400`; `PASS_KL_V5 configs=749398 cheap=749347 exact=18 envelope-box2-families=33`; `PASS_KL_REALIZABLE_V5 instances=120 violations=0 min-box=5`; `PASS_KL_ALL v5-configs=749398 envelope-families=33 realizable=120`; `PASS_KL_PROBE model-ok=142 tau>=1-all=0`; `PASS_KL_SHAPES shapes=6 screen-rejected=15`; `PASS_KL_HUNT tested=35 hits=0`; `PASS_KL_FAMILY_ALL shapes=6 hunt-tested=35 hunt-hits=0`; `PASS_KJ_V3 configs=3023 box-equals-cert=2996 candidates=27 certmax-cache=64`; `PASS_KL_SHAREABLE candidates=27 replay={"not-found-in-cap": 21, "realized": 3, "unrealizable-column": 3} push-final={"not-found-in-cap": 21, "realized": 3, "unrealizable-column": 3} counterexamples=3`; `PASS_KL_VERIFY v5-configs=749398 families=33 shapes=6 realizable=120 hunt=35 shareable=27 pins=57 digest=0d393ada94fd3809`. The vendored PR 3012 anchor replay prints `PASS_KM_ANCHORS markers=12 digest=0b5b55f84375b37c vendored-verify=exit0`, re-running the vendored PR 2978 `verify.py` unchanged (including `PASS_FG_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22 reach=0/12,8/19` and `PASS_KJ_COUNTEREXAMPLE v=3 tau=2/2/2 cert=3 box=2 r_box=2 independent=3/2`) and the PR 3012 markers `PASS_KM_VERIFY falsifiers=4 lb2=16761 mixed=240 v3-configs=3023 pivot=240 digest=fb29a75bde520732`. `research_package.py --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS` (not a mathematical acceptance check).

## Open next questions

1. **The tau >= 1 box floor at `v = 6`** (threshold 4): the same envelope classification (6-line multisets) and blocking-Z enumeration with constraint propagation; smallest falsifying instance first.
2. **The 20 remaining shareable-class patterns**: the kernel feasibility condition settles the `Z` side exactly; the anchor side needs a valuation-level realizability characterization.
3. **F-star at general `v`**: the box rung covers the whole tau >= 1 domain for `v <= 5`; the `tau = 0` region lives in the named rung. A joint lower bound in the shareable-class vocabulary is the natural next lemma.
